ownership.reason: JourneyBinding is shared distribution authority reserved to the Ultra root.
root_owned_symbols: JourneyBinding marketplace identity and binding digest
ownership.external_effects: locked and offline local validation in isolated /private/tmp roots only

required_behavior: Every production distribution journey binds one validated canonical marketplace name into its identity digest.
The marketplace comes from the already validated host-scope and marketplace-plan join, not CacheExpectation.
Cache promotion rejects absent, malformed, mismatched, or self-consistently substituted marketplace identity.
Package, version, home, tree, context, candidate, observation, and journey guards remain exact.
Read, reconcile, and query paths remain recursively zero-write.
permitted_dependency_updates: Only direct JourneyBinding construction sites whose compilation or exact marketplace semantics require migration; no manifest, Cargo.lock, public command, migration registry, generated authority, claim, or release edit.
required_validation: wrong version, plugin, home, tree, context, candidate, observation, and journey negatives
focused suite twice, dependency-closed distribution and host-lifecycle suites, full distribution, all targets, receipt parser, exact artifact set, and false-pass controls with 16 jobs and threads
stop_rule: Stop on ambiguous marketplace authority, unbounded compatibility fallback, any external mutation, or any required root-owned surface outside this dependency-closed journey schema.
no_claim_statement: This root correction does not claim package identity acceptance, installation, cache, marketplace, app-registry, Plugins UI, discovery, runtime, readiness, release, node closure, or completion.
